resources.string: Makes a ZettaBridge-ready copy of your own Haegemonia: Legions of Iron or Imperium Galactica 2 APK, so the old 32-bit game can run on a 64-bit-only phone through the separate ZettaBridge launcher. This app contains no game files and no ZettaBridge code - it only modifies your own file. Pick the ORIGINAL, unpatched game APK. The result (…-zb.apk) is NOT installed: import it in the ZettaBridge launcher.

SoA32to64
Version %1$s

Prepares your own copy of an old 32-bit game for the separate ZettaBridge launcher, so it can run on a 64-bit-only CPU. For devices whose CPU can run 32-bit apps use the companion project SoA instead.

This app contains no game files and no ZettaBridge code, and does not download any. It is an independent helper, not affiliated with ZettaBridge.
